claims.claim_text: The core ChauffeurNet model consists of a FeatureNet and an AgentRNN.
claims.normalized_text: ChauffeurNet model includes FeatureNet and AgentRNN.

claims.claim_text: A co-trained road mask prediction net and PerceptionRNN are part of the model.
claims.normalized_text: Model includes co-trained road mask prediction net and PerceptionRNN.

claims.claim_text: Training losses are shown in blue and ground-truth data labels in green in the model diagram.
claims.normalized_text: Training losses are indicated in blue and ground-truth labels in green in the model diagram.

claims.claim_text: The input representation uses box representation of other dynamic objects and samples lights and dynamic objects over the past Tscene seconds, while past agent poses are sampled over a potentially longer interval of Tpose seconds.
claims.normalized_text: Input representation samples lights and dynamic objects over Tscene seconds and agent poses over Tpose seconds using box representation.

claims.claim_text: The box representation of dynamic objects makes it easy to generate input data from simulation or from real-sensor logs using a standard perception system that detects and tracks objects.
claims.normalized_text: Box representation facilitates input data generation from simulation or real-sensor logs with standard perception systems.

claims.claim_text: This input representation enables testing and validation of models in closed-loop simulations before running them on a real car.
claims.normalized_text: Input representation enables closed-loop simulation testing and validation before real car deployment.
